baseline_commit: b2a50c6 (pose conversion also unchanged in 08b62c3 archive)
method: Serial ABBA fresh processes, 64 metadata reads from each original SER after one excluded warm read. Timed metadata includes trailer reads, exact epoch conversion and duration/cadence statistics. Own process CPU and contended wall time are separate.
interpretation: Vectorized integer epoch subtraction avoids a per-timestamp Python loop while retaining exact nonnegative tick differences, including signed-boundary spans. Median CPU for 64 reads falls from 0.14 to 0.015 seconds for Saturn and 0.82 to 0.07 seconds for Mars. These are metadata microbenchmarks; fixed metadata is already read only once in the screening loop.
validation: 82 timing/exposure/viewing tests passed, including signed/unsigned integer limits, nonnative endian timestamps, one-tick differences at large epochs, ties, invalid order and complete metadata parity.
